summary: Gorilla Technology Group Inc. issued a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, updating holders of its $125 million 7.50% Senior Unsecured Convertible Notes, Series B due 2031, issued July 17, 2026. The filing is purely procedural: it confirms an August 12, 2026 registration statement filing, SEC non-review notification on August 14, and distribution of a draft prospectus supplement to known holders on August 15. The company expects the registration statement to be declared effective on August 21, 2026. No transaction, special event, or structural change is announced. The notes were previously issued; this filing solely addresses registration rights compliance.
